ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) coverage estimated at 75-80%, with high-intensity (white/grey) mottling accounting for the remaining 20-25% localized on distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels form irregular mottled clusters on the distal 1/4th of both the left and right lobes; the central 1/2 of the fluke surface is contiguous low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep trajectory curving upward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical light-grey linear streaks detected on the outer left lobe, distinct from primary mottling patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of white barnacles (Coronula diadema) attached to the distal margins of both fluke lobes.
